subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Does current-main iOS LAN/VPN reconnect proof show that PR 98066 fully resolves this repeated node reapproval loop, including the manual setup path?
rationale: Source inspection proves the QR/bootstrap token-loss class is fixed, but the reported manual setup path and current dynamic permission reconciliation can still produce reapproval without a token persistence failure.

options.title: Require current-main iPhone reconnect proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or iOS owner pairs once, force-closes and reopens several times, and records whether `nodes status/list` stays approved or returns to pending reapproval.

options.title: Close as fixed by PR 98066 with existing proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers already have private proof that the QR and manual setup reconnect paths no longer create a new pending reapproval.

options.title: Start a separate narrow fix after proof
options.body: If the proof still reproduces reapproval, repair the iOS stable declaration or gateway reapproval comparison instead of adding another token persistence change.

recommendation.title: Require current-main iPhone reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or iOS owner pairs once, force-closes and reopens several times, and records whether `nodes status/list` stays approved or returns to pending reapproval.
